 [REPLAY] Ana Marshall – Applied Direct Investing at the William and Flora Hewlett Foundation (Capital Allocators, EP.111) Jan 8, 2024

 Ana Marshall is the Vice President and Chief
Investment Officer for The William and Flora Hewlett Foundation,
where she oversees a $10.5 billion pool of capital. Ana joined
Hewlett in 2004 after spending eighteen years as a direct investor
in high yield credit, emerging market debt, and international
equities.

 Our conversation covers Ana’s lifelong passion for
investing, joining the “super buy side,” conducting company
meetings to inform the manager selection and allocation process,
portfolio structure, manager selection, monitoring and measuring
risk, perspectives on peers, internal dynamics, and working through
a big mistake.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
